job: F3 native Auth and browser integration
step: Complete F3 synthetic Auth and HTTPS browser suite

isolatedReproduction.method: An ephemeral checkout of the exact source SHA used a separate loopback F3 port range because the default local F3 port was already occupied by another disposable target. Temporary AUTH-14 instrumentation recorded only allowlisted stage, route, auth status, alert category, SDK error class, and logout-response presence; no credentials, token values, raw browser output, or persistent DEV resources were collected.
isolatedReproduction.failurePoint: settledLogin after local logout and same-context callback
isolatedReproduction.interpretation: A concurrent refresh result was discarded after local Auth state had changed. The local session was already absent, but the account UI surfaced the discarded refresh as a logout failure and stayed on the account route, so AUTH-14 did not reach its signup UI observation.

resolution.rule: Only the public Supabase isAuthRefreshDiscardedError result from signOut with scope local is normalized to error:null; errors for global and others, all other errors, and scope validation are preserved.
